crossRefs.note: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
David spoke to Yahweh when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done…
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall…
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body…
For each man will bear his own burden.

translations.web: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
translations.bsb: Even if I have truly gone astray, my error concerns me alone.
translations.kjv: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth
translations.asv: And be it indeed that I have erred, Mine error remaineth with myself.
